test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - General Knowledge (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following options best describes the objective of Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) Scheme, 2016?

options.text: To provide financial assistance to entrepreneurs
To provide free healthcare services to the unemployed
To provide employment opportunities for rural women
To encourage employers to create new jobs

solution:
The correct answer is __**To encourage employers to create new jobs.**__
